description: Average Daily Traffic Counts is a dataset listed in City of Chicago open data portal (data.cityofchicago.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Chicago. Average Daily Traffic (ADT) counts around the City of Chicago. Data are collected from over 800 traffic and speed enforcement cameras 24/7/365. Traffic counts are a by-product of these cameras that are primarily used for other operational purposes. Coverage: Chicago. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are traffic, link to article present. The table has 22 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Chicago. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofchicago-org-portal.
